composed.claimText: Derived (p.1, p.2): The machine deck for a normal game is 9 face-up-drawable machine part cards stacked on top of the face-down Doom Core, so the Doom Core is the final card of the deck. Of those 9, the top 3 are immediately revealed in step 5, leaving 6 face down above the Doom Core.
